secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxxxxxx.supabase.co) from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project URL. Currently overridden by a local PostgREST proxy — remove the override in docker-compose.base44.yml when the real project is restored.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Your Supabase project anon/public key from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project API keys (anon public). Currently overridden by a local JWT — remove the override in docker-compose.base44.yml when the real project is restored.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel personal access token (from vercel.com → Account Settings → Tokens). Team-scoped token for team 'eis6', used to deploy/manage the mamlakahcommunity Vercel project via API.

secrets.name: VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Your Cloudinary cloud name from the Cloudinary dashboard (Console > Settings > Account). Used for uploading receipt images and videos via unsigned uploads.

secrets.name: VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
secrets.description: An unsigned upload preset name from Cloudinary (Console > Settings > Upload > Upload presets). Create one with signing mode 'Unsigned' to allow client-side uploads.
